## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit message follows Conventional Commits (`type: subject`) — enforced, PRs that don't comply are returned
- [ ] Searched existing PRs/issues for duplicates
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest -q`)

- [ ] Release-note-worthy changes are written so they can be counted (numbers, not adjectives)
